scripts.build: npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-sqlite --test dist/tests/*.test.js && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:mcp:real: npm run build && RUN_REAL_CODEX_MCP=1 node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-sqlite --test --test-name-pattern='real authenticated Codex' dist/tests/mcp.test.js
